contract_gaps.head_aliases: The closed REST binding supports GET, POST, PUT, PATCH, and DELETE, not HEAD. All nine HEAD operations are existence or ping aliases with admitted GET companions on the same path.
contract_gaps.get_request_bodies: The connection adapter deliberately strips GET bodies. All 78 GET-with-body aliases have admitted POST or PUT companions on the same path, preserving the request-body capability without pretending the GET alias is buildable.
contract_gaps.ndjson: Eight admitted bulk and multi-search operations require literal newline-delimited JSON. They expose body_raw and send application/x-ndjson; the caller must include the final newline.
contract_gaps.streaming_inference: The two admitted inference _stream operations require a streaming-capable client. The static adapter requests text/event-stream, buffers the finite SSE response, returns raw event-stream text after completion, and does not expose incremental chunks.
contract_gaps.version_scope: The pack pins the official 9.4 branch contract. Deployments on other major or minor versions can expose a different endpoint and schema surface.
contract_gaps.connection_origin: Elasticsearch deployment origins vary by Elastic Cloud region and by self-managed installation. The connection is per-org, uses a placeholder HTTPS origin only as an enrollment example, and owns the complete Authorization value.
contract_gaps.preview_operations: The official 9.4 contract includes beta and experimental operations. They remain visible for full feature coverage, are labeled from x-state, and every preview read is marked sensitive-read.
contract_gaps.arbitrary_documents: Elasticsearch document bodies and search responses have user-defined schemas. The pack uses raw JSON where the official schema is open or union-shaped and does not declare a generic task, note, or project Source.
